upload_contract.start: Upload as START frame; exact first-frame anchor.
upload_contract.key: Upload as KEY frame; peak beat reference.
upload_contract.end: Upload as END frame; final-frame target.

reject_focus: Keep monitor_required until the Japanese dialogue prompt is reviewed against the uploaded START/KEY/END frames and a 3-second motion probe confirms Lonato age/identity, active student reactions, non-graphic restraint, and a moving tail hold.
promotion_rule: Do not promote to approved_for_video from this package alone. A human or separate reviewer must inspect the generated 3-second clip and record motion_review_passed before full-duration generation.
